text.body: arthāvabodhakamanarthakañca sarvamapi śabdajātaṃ dhvanirityaparanāmnā vyavahriyate । uktañca pātañjalamahābhāṣyasya paspaśāhnike "athavā pratītapadārthako loke dhvaniḥ śabdaḥ" iti । anena sārthakasya śabdasya dhvanirūpatvaṃ pramāṇatāmāyāti । nirarthako'pi śabdo dhvaniriti tu loke prasiddhameva । kiñca, nūtanadhvanivijñānaloke sarvavidho'pi śabdaḥ dhvanirucyate । saṃvitsvarūpā mantravīryātmā parā vāga, atha ca paśyantī, madhyameti vāktrayamapi dhvanipadena vyapadiśyate । tadyathā evaṃ trividhavisargāveśasamāpattidhāmni ya udeti । saṃvit parimarśātmā dhvanistadeva mantravīrya syāt ।। atra "saṃvit parimarśātma" iti padena parāvāg gṛhyate । paśyantyāśca parāvāṅmūlatvāt sā'pi dhvanisvarūpā। madhyamāyā vāco dhvaniśabdena vyavahāro yogacūḍāmaṇyupaniṣadi proktaḥ । tadyathā tailadhārāmivācchinnaṃ dīrghaghaṇṭāninādavat । praṇavasya dhvanistadvat tadanaṃ brahma cocyate ॥8॥ evaṃ sarvavidhasyāpi śabdasya śāstrakāravanītyaparanāmnā vyavahārāta sarvo'pi śabdo dhvanināmāhaḥ । tena "akārādivarṇā eva dhvanipadavācyāḥ, na tu parādivāca" iti na svīkaraṇīyam । dhvaniśabdayorabhedavyavahārādeva "dhvanireva śabdaḥ" iti vaiyākaraṇānāṃ samayaḥ । uktañca śrībhartṛhariṇā vākyapadīyasya brahmakāṇḍe ātmabhedastayoḥ kecidastītyāhuḥ purāṇagāḥ । buddhibhedādabhedasya bhedamekepracakṣate ॥ iti । pātañjalamahābhāṣyasya paspaśāhnike ca athavā "pratītapadārthako loke dhvaniḥ śabda ityucyate, tadyathā śabdaṃ kuru","mā śabdaṃ kārṣīḥ", "śabdakāryayaṃ māṇavakaḥ" iti dhvani kurvannevamucyate । tasmād dhvaniḥ śabdaḥ । atra dhvanireva śabdaḥ । dhvaniśabdayorabhedasambandhaḥ । dhvani vinā śabdasya tattvena na pratītirato dhvanireva śabdaḥ।
